content: Abdominal distension is most commonly caused by the accumulation of gas or an intolerance to certain types of food. However, in some cases, it may indicate the presence of a more serious underlying disease or medical condition. For this reason, if the abdominal distension is a new symptom, appears different from previous experiences, or does not improve with over-the-counter medications, it is strongly advised to consult a physician for further evaluation. Abdominal distension can be a clinical manifestation of numerous conditions that affect various organ systems within the body. Identifying the underlying cause is essential for appropriate management. Surgical intervention is required in cases where the underlying cause of the abdominal distension is determined to be a bowel obstruction, a hernia, or a tumor.
